Active Site Sorter

PDB 8F3W · Penicillin-binding protein 5 · E. faecium · 3.0 Å

Active Site Sorter

Penicillin G is your puzzle piece. Find the pocket on the protein where it fits, then submit. Your pose is scored against the crystal structure.

How to play
  • The protein pushes back, so the piece rolls over the surface as you drag it. Flick it and it keeps rolling.
  • Get close to the binding site and it starts to pull the piece in. Let go and it settles into place.
  • The piece turns from blue to red and rattles harder as you get closer to where it binds. When it fits it glows; let go and it snaps in.
  • Drag the piece to move it. Shift-drag, or switch to Turn, to rotate it.
  • Drag the background to orbit, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
  • A D spin the piece on the spot.
  • Double-click the protein to orbit around that spot.
  • Enter submits.
